promotions.name: Afternoon Happy Hour
promotions.rule: 20% off all South Indian Beverages, daily between 2:00 PM and 4:00 PM.

eligibility.notes: Applies automatically at checkout during the time window; no code needed.

promotions.name: Tiffin + Coffee Combo
promotions.rule: Get any Tiffins-category item for 50% off when purchased alongside any South Indian Beverage.

eligibility.notes: Discount applies across qualifying Tiffins items if multiple are ordered.

promotions.name: Student Discount
promotions.rule: 10% off entire order for students with a valid student ID.

eligibility.notes: Requires staff verification of student ID at pickup; seasonal promotion, currently expired.
